title: RGB-trained 3DGS comparison from a matched compact initialization
question: At the same frozen 3D initialization and camera split, what image quality, silhouette behavior, runtime, memory, and final capacity does standard image-supervised 3DGS produce relative to the saved compact-only result?
hypothesis: Image-supervised 3DGS improves held-out RGB quality at a substantially larger reconstruction-process memory cost than compact-only optimization.
claim_boundary: Development comparison of standard image-supervised optimization from a matched compact initialization. It is not Original 3DGS because no COLMAP sparse point model is present, and it does not include RGB-to-2D fitting cost in the compact arm.

stages.label: Load matched initialization
stages.purpose: Load the exact saved compact-arm initialization and verify its hash, count, and parameters.

stages.label: Load train RGB/masks
stages.purpose: Load only the frozen training cameras with calibrated undistortion and lossless PNG masks.

stages.label: Standard 3DGS optimization
stages.purpose: Run the repository's standard RGB trainer and frozen density strategy under a hard Gaussian budget.

stages.label: Held-out RGB evaluation
stages.purpose: Evaluate the RGB-trained and saved compact-only models on identical held-out RGB/mask cameras.

stages.label: Paired resource contrast
stages.purpose: Join independent process receipts without charging RGB files to the compact reconstruction process.

comparators.label: Saved compact-only model
comparators.purpose: Offline image evaluation of the immutable compact output; no RGB gradients or post-hoc compact tuning.

comparators.label: RGB 3DGS from bounded random initialization
comparators.purpose: Lower-bound image-supervised control at the same initial count and hard final capacity.

comparators.label: RGB 3DGS with fixed topology
comparators.purpose: Separates image-supervision value from standard densification and capacity growth.

comparators.label: Original 3DGS from COLMAP
comparators.purpose: Explicitly unavailable until a real cameras/images/points3D sparse model is produced and sealed.

primary_metrics.aggregation: median per view, then paired median over seeds and scenes

primary_metrics.label: Held-out SSIM
primary_metrics.aggregation: median per view, then paired median over seeds and scenes

primary_metrics.label: Held-out LPIPS
primary_metrics.aggregation: median per view, then paired median over seeds and scenes

primary_metrics.label: Held-out alpha IoU
primary_metrics.aggregation: median per view, then paired median over seeds and scenes

primary_metrics.label: Held-out exterior alpha leakage
primary_metrics.aggregation: maximum and median per view, paired over seeds and scenes

primary_metrics.label: Peak CUDA allocated
primary_metrics.aggregation: paired median over measured repeats, seeds, and scenes

primary_metrics.label: Peak CUDA reserved
primary_metrics.aggregation: paired median over measured repeats, seeds, and scenes

primary_metrics.label: Optimization wall time
primary_metrics.aggregation: paired median over measured repeats, seeds, and scenes

resource_protocol.scope: fresh image-supervised process from calibrated train-image open through final PLY save; heldout evaluation is timed and reported separately
resource_protocol.aggregation: paired median on the same idle named GPU as the compact arm; retain every raw repeat and report min/max

blockers: Finish and hash the direct_compact task output used as the matched Beam-independent initialization.
Freeze the standard gsplat density strategy, hard count budget, iterations, and per-arm tuning rule before changing status to ready.
Freeze soft-PNG alpha handling and the threshold used for binary IoU/leakage metrics.
Use the compact arm's frozen GPU, idle threshold, NVML sampler, repeat count, and fresh-process boundary.
Implement the task-specific runner and shared report producer without reusing held-out cameras for checkpoint or hyperparameter selection.
A true Original-3DGS comparator remains unavailable until a real COLMAP sparse model is sealed.
Add at least one outcome-unseen scene before promoting a general quality or VRAM claim.
